#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

## 20261016 (Sprint 151) Codex rev 0 Path: ./scripts/shared/task_custody.py
## Purpose: Drain custody-bearing async work before propagating caller cancellation.
##

"""Cancellation cannot abandon received credential successors or receipt durability work."""

import asyncio
from threading import Event


async def await_custody_task[T](task: asyncio.Task[T], cancelled: Event | None = None) -> T:
    """Signal cooperative cancellation and drain even when cancellation repeats."""
    try:
        return await asyncio.shield(task)
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        if cancelled is not None:
            cancelled.set()
        while not task.done():
            try:
                await asyncio.shield(task)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                continue
            except Exception:
                break
        if task.done() and not task.cancelled():
            task.exception()
        raise
